description: hugoh/hk-config//renovate.json is extended here so every consumer gets its custom managers (the hugoh/hk-config and jdx/hk pins in *.pkl / mise.toml) and its global disable of the built-in mise manager for `hk`. Repos with no hk.pkl are unaffected — those managers just match nothing. Since ~every repo uses hk.pkl, this is injected in the base rather than opted into per repo.

packageRules.description: Same window as presets/weekend. Inlined because renovate-config-validator resolves a packageRules `extends` from main, so it can't see a preset added in the same change; switch to extending presets/weekend once that preset is on main.

First-party reusable workflows and composite actions: a bump only reaches consumers once a new tag is cut, so propagate within a day and automerge. Restricted to the repos that own these workflows/actions. Needs its own groupName so it isn't swallowed into the "minor updates"/"patch updates" groups above, which would otherwise pull in their monthly/weekly schedules instead of "at any time".
